nodes.summary: Let $F$ be the free group on countably many generators $x_0, x_1, x_2, \dots$ and let $W \subseteq F$ be a set of laws. The variety defined by $W$ has an independent basis of identities if there is a set $B \subseteq F$ of laws such that a law is a consequence of $B$ exactly when it is a consequence of $W$, and no $b \in B$ is a consequence of $B \setminus \{b\}$.
nodes.title: Independent basis of laws

nodes.summary: The quasi-identities of a group $G$ have an independent basis if there is a set $B$ of quasi-identities such that a quasi-identity is a consequence of $B$ exactly when it holds in $G$, and no $b \in B$ is a consequence of $B \setminus \{b\}$.
nodes.title: Independent basis of quasi-identities

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be the free group on countably many generators $x_0, x_1, x_2, \dots$, let $W \subseteq F$ be a set of laws and let $w \in F$. Then $w$ is a consequence of $W$ if $w$ holds in every group $G$ satisfying all laws in $W$: whenever every homomorphism $F \to G$ sends each element of $W$ to $1$, every homomorphism $F \to G$ sends $w$ to $1$.
nodes.title: Consequence of a set of laws

nodes.summary: Let $Q$ be a set of quasi-identities and $q$ a quasi-identity. Then $q$ is a consequence of $Q$ if $q$ holds in every group in which all members of $Q$ hold.
nodes.title: Consequence of a set of quasi-identities

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
